verdict.rationale: Metronome is a usage-based billing platform, so a natural-language command interface is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack documents no such capability. The llms.txt file, OpenAPI spec, SDKs and Postman collection are developer building blocks an agent could use. They are not a first-party way to operate the product with natural-language commands, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
